name: CE_BANK_BRANCH_IDENTIFIERS
description: This table stores the information about the network specific identifiers of banks or branches

columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_IDENTIFIER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier provided to bank or branch institution by the network.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of banking entity for which additional identifiers are provided by the payment network. Values from the lookup type ORA_CE_BANKING_ENTITY_TYPE are valid.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NETWORK_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the payment network codes. Values from the lookup type ORA_CE_PAYMENT_NETWORK_TYPE are valid.

columns.name: BANK_OR_BRANCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of bank or branch.

columns.name: NETWORK_BANK_BRANCH_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Unique identifier of bank or branch institution provided by the payment network.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_NETWORK_ATTRIBUTES
columns.description: Network specific attributes to identify a financial institution.
